correctness.rationale: Reconstructed unit-ball spindle containment as nonoverlap of two spherical caps about sampled directions, with exact angular threshold arcsin(epsilon*t/2)+arcsin(epsilon*s/2). Polar and spherical normal coordinates with uniform bounded support and dominated convergence prove the epsilon^(d-1) limit for every centrally symmetric convex body (including polytopes) in d>=2. The (3d-1)-power radial moment follows from integrating t^(d-1)s^(d-1)(t+s)^(d-1). The polar volume identity and Jensen yield exact equal-volume ball minimization and strict equality; convex tangent inequality yields (2-1/d) E[(M-1)^2] deficit. Elongated equal-volume boxes make the coefficient unbounded. Independently checked J_d exact fractions for d=2..7, the ball constants 2/(3*pi) for d2 and 93/640 for d3, and Monte Carlo/numerical components separately from the proof. Finite checks are corroborative only.
